name: Donkey Kicks at the Footbar
summary: On hands and knees on the carriage facing the straps, one foot on the footbar behind you. That leg presses back to move the carriage.
steps: Kneel on the carriage facing the straps, hands on the shoulder rests or the carriage edge.
Place the ball of one foot on the footbar behind you, knee bent under the hip.
Breathe out to press the foot into the bar until the leg is nearly straight; the carriage travels away from the bar.
Breathe in to bend the knee and return with control.

layers.title: Hover the supporting knee
layers.text: Lift it a couple of centimetres.

cautions.note: Keep the ribs drawn in and the range small.

cues:
Back stays flat like a table top.
Push from the seat, not by arching the lower back.
Hips stay level and square.
Shoulders stay over the hands.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Forearms on the carriage for sore wrists
